text.value: The IG's repository has a script or program in sub-folders: scripts/seed-comparison-cache.sh. The IG Publisher doesn't run them, but they arrive with every pull: don't run them unless you know what they do. Scripts and programs don't belong in an IG's repository

The IG's repository has 8 scripts or programs in its root folder (/home/runner/work/kerndatensatz-kardiologie/kerndatensatz-kardiologie): _build.bat, _build.sh, _gencontinuous.bat, _gencontinuous.sh, _genonce.bat, _genonce.sh, _updatePublisher.bat, _updatePublisher.sh. Scripts and programs don't belong in an IG's repository: they arrive with every pull, and people run them out of habit, so anyone who can change the repository can run code on the computer of everyone who builds the IG. Remove them from the repository (people who want them can get them from their source, and keep them out of the IG's repository). IMPORTANT: in a future version of the IG Publisher, the build will stop here, and the ci-build will refuse to build the IG. If you accept these as they are, you can say so now by running the IG Publisher with '-allow-committed-scripts' (recorded in /home/runner/work/_temp/fhir-settings.json, for this IG), and local builds will go on then (but not the ci-build). The IG Publisher doesn't check what they do: accepting them is your decision
This IG is for FHIR version 4.0.1, while the package 'hl7.fhir.uv.subscriptions-backport.r4#1.1.0' is for FHIR version 4.0.0

The SNOMED CT code 266929003 ('Smoking started') is a finding, but the observation has a result as its value: the code of an observation with a result says what was observed (an observable entity, or an evaluation procedure), and a finding goes in the value, or in a Condition. A finding can be the code when there is no value, or the value says whether it is present (a boolean, or a yes/no code)
